        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "UpdateHvReviewerCommand promises automatic NONCE after a configuration change (632), but HvWorkerHost requests NONCE only at startup (1372-1389). The claim path consumes only ProbeRequestedUtc (941), which update does not set. The promise needs a durable configuration-change probe request and polling/restart coverage.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F04",
        "title": "An old probe can qualify a new reviewer configuration",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:484",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:632",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1016",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-003-AC001"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "A probe started for configuration A can finish after PATCH changes the reviewer to configuration B, then CloseHvRunOutputCommand unconditionally marks B Online (632, 1016). No captured reviewer configuration version exists on HvRun (484-490), nor does the probe close compare one. Readiness must bind to the configuration actually probed; add a stale-probe race criterion.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F05",
        "title": "Probe failures enter a request-only retry policy",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:484",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1045",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1346",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1395",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-003-AC003",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-009"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "FailHvRunCommand always calls the review-request-only HvRetryDecision (1045-1067, 1346), although a Probe has no HvRequestId (484) and a failed launch or nonzero probe exit uses this same command (1395). The probe failure and shutdown outcomes require an explicit branch, with offline/incident and retry semantics tested.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F06",
        "title": "Reviewer-turn verification accepts an incomplete or open audit turn",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:166",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:544",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:553",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1283",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-010",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC010"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "V-6 accepts a reviewer turn containing only the compact hv_verdict (1283, 553). It does not require the entire result or a closed Chore turn, as P-06 and the brief require (544). A persisted summary-only or open turn can pass finalization. Verification and negative criteria must check the complete result and required terminal state.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F07",
        "title": "The stored result contains its own unspecified content hash",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:494",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:562",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-011",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-015"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "HvEvidence stores the result document with only responseLog removed (494), while that document contains evidence.result.sha256 (562), and its Sha256 hashes the decompressed stored bytes (494). No exclusion/projection defines a hashable payload without its own hash. Define one canonical stored payload and add its digest to the returned envelope, with a named hash/round-trip case.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F08",
        "title": "Incident filing writes before the audit hard-stop guard",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:369",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1156",
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1165",
          "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-018-AC002"
        ],
        "defectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "FileHvIncidentCommand calls the writing triage service before AuditLedgerGuard (1156, 1163-1171), contrary to the hard-stop rule that no HV unit writes while the ledger is unavailable (369, FR-MCP-HVPIPE-018-AC002). Its diagram also puts Filed and notification writes after an edge labeled committed. The guard and audited triage write need an enforceable ordering/transaction boundary, and the diagram must put local outcome and notification inside the transaction.",
        "classification": "implementer edit"
      },
      {
        "id": "F09",
        "title": "P1 misstates the live requirement satisfaction flag",
        "location": [
          "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2509",
